_doc: VID/PID -> device descriptor, from page-f17bd796bc939422.js const `en` (~pretty line 13268). Each model has 2 PIDs: the normal-mode keyboard PID (filter usagePage 0x0001 usage 0x0000; this is the one you configure) and a second PID (filter usagePage 0xFF00 usage 0x0001) which the app treats as firmware-update/bootloader mode (connecting to it sets updateMode=true and does not configure; see bootloaderModePIDs). PIDs 0x3250 and 0xA026 are shared (2.4G dongles?) and disambiguated by HIDDevice.productName. features are derived from deviceType gating in the official code (see PROTOCOL.md section 'Per-device differences').
